Name:🤝 Welcome
Comment:Welcome at enrollment (onboarding assisted by study nurse). Introducing the coaching program and collection of user data (nickname, schedule preferences, etc.). Recruited patients will be registered for the first time in the study using REDCap. The REDCap database will have the records of the patient's age, gender, ethnicity, body weight and size, attending physician, etc.) REDCap provides an API that CLAID should be able to use to retrieve some of the data entered into REDCap. We emphatically want to avoid the situation in which the study nurse has to enter the information twice because the two systems do not talk to each other.

Rule://+ moment // import moment from 'moment' /* Snippet saves objects of completed acq with timestamp and its score */ const acq_timestamp = '$acq_timestamp' * 1 const acq_score = '$acq_score' * 1 const acq_history = '$acq_history' //'[{ "acq_score": 1, "acq_date": "21.02.2026" }]' const acq_date = moment(acq_timestamp).format('DD.MM.YYYY') acq_date let parsedAcq_history = []; try { const parsed = JSON.parse(acq_history); if (Array.isArray(parsed)) { parsedAcq_history = parsed; } } catch (e) { console.error('Invalid JSON:', e) } parsedAcq_history.push({acq_score, acq_date}); const resultObject = { acq_history: JSON.stringify(parsedAcq_history) }; resultObject; execute javascript in x and store values but result is always true ---

Micro Dialog Decision Point
Comment:JavaScript snippet for sensor data daily summary
Rules:
Rule://+ moment import moment from 'moment' /* Snippet reads sensor data variables, groups entries by date, and updates a historical daily summary in $dailyTaskSummaryData. Returns the full history as dailyTaskSummaryData and today's values as individual variables. */ const spirometerDataRaw = "$spirometerData"; const smartInhalerDataRaw = "$smartInhalerData"; const sleepDataRaw = "$sleepData"; const coughDataRaw = "$coughData"; const dailyTaskSummaryDataRaw = "$dailyTaskSummaryData"; const today = "$today"; // expected format: "YYYY-MM-DD" // Parse all sensor variables safely let spirometerData = []; let smartInhalerData = []; let sleepData = []; let coughData = []; let dailyTaskSummaryData = []; try { const p = JSON.parse(spirometerDataRaw); if (Array.isArray(p)) spirometerData = p; } catch (e) { console.error("Invalid spirometerData:", e); } try { const p = JSON.parse(smartInhalerDataRaw); if (Array.isArray(p)) smartInhalerData = p; } catch (e) { console.error("Invalid smartInhalerData:", e); } try { const p = JSON.parse(sleepDataRaw); if (Array.isArray(p)) sleepData = p; } catch (e) { console.error("Invalid sleepData:", e); } try { const p = JSON.parse(coughDataRaw); if (Array.isArray(p)) coughData = p; } catch (e) { console.error("Invalid coughData:", e); } try { const p = JSON.parse(dailyTaskSummaryDataRaw); if (Array.isArray(p)) dailyTaskSummaryData = p; } catch (e) { console.error("Invalid dailyTaskSummaryData:", e); } // Helper: convert unix timestamp (ms) to YYYY-MM-DD const tsToDate = (ts) => moment(ts * 1).format("YYYY-MM-DD"); // Collect all unique dates from all sensor arrays const allDates = new Set(); spirometerData.forEach((e) => { if (e.timestamp) allDates.add(tsToDate(e.timestamp)); }); smartInhalerData.forEach((e) => { if (e.timestamp) allDates.add(tsToDate(e.timestamp)); }); sleepData.forEach((e) => { if (e.window_date) allDates.add(e.window_date); }); coughData.forEach((e) => { if (e.window_end_unix_ms) allDates.add(tsToDate(e.window_end_unix_ms)); }); // For each date, calculate counts and update or append in the history allDates.forEach((date) => { const spirometerEntries = spirometerData.filter( (e) => tsToDate(e.timestamp) === date && e.testValid === "1" ).length; const smartInhalerEntries = smartInhalerData.filter( (e) => tsToDate(e.timestamp) === date ).length; const sleepDataEntries = sleepData.filter( (e) => e.window_date === date ).length; const coughEntry = coughData.find( (e) => tsToDate(e.window_end_unix_ms) === date ); const coughCount = coughEntry ? parseInt(coughEntry.cough_count) : 0; const newEntry = { date, spirometerEntries, smartInhalerEntries, sleepDataEntries, coughCount, }; const existingIndex = dailyTaskSummaryData.findIndex((e) => e.date === date); if (existingIndex >= 0) { dailyTaskSummaryData[existingIndex] = newEntry; } else { dailyTaskSummaryData.push(newEntry); } }); // Extract today's values for individual output variables const todayEntry = dailyTaskSummaryData.find((e) => e.date === today) || { spirometerEntries: 0, smartInhalerEntries: 0, sleepDataEntries: 0, coughCount: 0, }; const resultObject = { dailyTaskSummaryData: JSON.stringify(dailyTaskSummaryData), spirometerEntries: todayEntry.spirometerEntries, smartInhalerEntries: todayEntry.smartInhalerEntries, sleepDataEntries: todayEntry.sleepDataEntries, coughCount: todayEntry.coughCount }; resultObject; execute javascript in x and store values but result is always true ---

en-GB:It seems like you’ve missed your medication a few times. I’m here to understand if something’s making it hard for you. Can you tell me what makes it difficult? (please select one or more options)

Name:Spirometry
Decision Points, Events & Messages:
Micro Dialog Message
Comment:Ask patient whether they would like to change the schedule of reminders for spirometry. To be triggered after asking the user, or if there is a large discrepancy between the currently scheduled reminders and the actual times at which spirometry was conducted.
Text (plain):
en-GB:Would you like to adjust the schedule of reminders for your spirometry measurements?
ro-RO:Vrei să modifici programul de reamintire pentru măsurătorile spirometrice?
Channel to send message:👤 App/partner message to participant
Answer type:select one
Answer options (with placeholders):
en-GB:Yes, please:1 No, the current schedule is fine:0
ro-RO:Da, te rog:1 Nu, programul actual este perfect:0
Store value to variable:$needToChangeRemindersScheduleForSpirometry
Micro Dialog Decision Point
Comment:Reschedule spirometry if requested by the user or if the user confirms rescheduling is needed as there is a large discrepancy between the currently scheduled reminders and the actual times at which spirometry was conducted.

Rule:$needToChangeRemindersScheduleForSpirometry calculated value equals 1
Comment:Requested or confirmed by the user
Variable to store value to:[not set]
Stop Micro Dialog when TRUE:NO ✋
Leave Decision Point when TRUE:NO ✋
Micro Dialog Message to jump to when TRUE:
en-GB:Please enter the new time of the day at which you normally would like to carry out your spirometry measurements.
ro-RO:Te rog să introduci ora preferată la care vrei să faci, în mod normal, măsurătorile spirometrice.
Micro Dialog Message to jump to when FALSE:
en-GB:It looks like you would like to keep the current schedule for spirometry, which is daily at $userSetDesiredSpirometryTime
ro-RO:Se pare că dorești să păstrezi programul actual pentru spirometrie, care este zilnic la $userSetDesiredSpirometryTime.

Comment:Inquire about new desired time of the day for spirometry
